senses.gloss: ? cedācitta, instr. cedācittena LV 〔431.12〕 (prose; so only one ms.; v.l., two mss., ˚cintena; all other mss. and Calc. have a haplographic omission here), is uninterpretable to me; I must assume a corruption, perhaps a misprint. Not noted by Weller. Foucauxʼs Tib. omits the passage. (The particle ced can, it seems, hardly be involved.)
